page_title: FUL 0-1 BOU | Fulham v Bournemouth 09/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Having seen unsporting behavior, Andy Madley shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is the recipient.
90+5' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+5' Oscar Bobb (Fulham) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the crossbar!

90+2' David Brooks (Bournemouth) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Andy Madley with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alex Toth (Bournemouth) will replace Alex Scott.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Fulham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
87' Fulham hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
83' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonah Kusi Asare (Fulham) replacing Timothy Castagne.
82' Joshua King (Fulham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
81' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
79' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Eli Junior Kroupi as he is replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
79' The substitution is prepared. David Brooks (Bournemouth) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rayan.
78' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Marcus Tavernier will be replaced by Amine Adli (Bournemouth).
77' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
77' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fulham.
76' Substitution. Tom Cairney walks off the pitch and Joshua King (Fulham) comes on as a substitute.
76' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Corner kick. Fulham will have an opportunity.
75' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Sasa Lukic (Fulham). Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Fulham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

74' Kevin (Fulham) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box towards the roof of the net, but Djordje Petrovic shows his agility and makes a save. Fulham have a corner.
70' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

69' Tom Cairney (Fulham) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fulham.
65' Yellow card! It's like Alex Scott (Bournemouth) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Andy Madley agrees and books him.

64' Ambitious effort from Oscar Bobb (Fulham). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
62' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Harry Wilson is replaced by Oscar Bobb (Fulham).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samuel Chukwueze trots off the pitch and is replaced by Kevin (Fulham).
59' The main referee, Andy Madley, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is given a yellow card for dissent.

59' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Bernd Leno inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the roof of the net, but was denied by a great save.
56' The attendance is 27626.
53' 0 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Rayan (Bournemouth) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom right corner.
52' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the crossbar.
50' Yellow card. Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

48' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Bernd Leno!
48' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

47' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marco Silva probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Emile Smith Rowe. He is replaced by Issa Diop (Fulham).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+7' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Andy Madley produces a RED card from his pocket and Joachim Andersen (Fulham) heads for an early shower!

45+6' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Joachim Andersen (Fulham), but referee Andy Madley must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
45+5' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45+1' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Timothy Castagne (Fulham) takes it short.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.

44' Crossbar! Harry Wilson (Fulham) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from around the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the bar! The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
43' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is coming onto the pitch as Evanilson cannot continue after picking up an injury.
41' He’s off! Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) gets his marching orders from referee Andy Madley after the VAR review.

40' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth), but referee Andy Madley must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
39' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
39' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
38' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Fulham win a corner.
36' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
36' A lofted cross from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee signals a corner kick to Bournemouth.
34' James Hill (Bournemouth) trips an opposition player and Andy Madley signals a foul.
32' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
31' Harry Wilson (Fulham) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Fulham will take a throw-in.

29' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
29' Tom Cairney (Fulham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
28' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
27' Harry Wilson (Fulham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
26' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
22' The foul by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) was seen by Andy Madley who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
20' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
20' Rayan (Bournemouth) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Now Bournemouth have a corner.
18' James Hill (Bournemouth) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball has crossed the sideline. Bournemouth are taking a throw-in.
16' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
12' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.

11' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
10' Evanilson (Bournemouth) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
9' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is behind the touchline and Bournemouth will take a throw-in.
8' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
7' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fulham.
5' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Andy Madley no option but to blow his whistle.
4' Harry Wilson (Fulham) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
1' The match has just started.
Bournemouth will kick-off.
Andy Madley will supervise the game today.
